mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )
mapper.select: SELECT template.consent_template_id, template.template_code, template.template_name, activity.activity_name AS processing_activity_name, template.template_status, published.version_number AS published_version_number, latest.workflow_status AS latest_workflow_status FROM seal.consent_template template JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = template.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.consent_template_version published ON published.consent_template_version_id = template.current_published_version_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT workflow_status FROM seal.consent_template_version version WHERE version.consent_template_id = template.consent_template_id ORDER BY version.version_number DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE (#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR template.template_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR template.template_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') AND (#{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR template.template_status = #{status}) ORDER BY template.template_code

SELECT template.consent_template_id, template.template_code, template.template_name, template.processing_activity_id, activity.activity_name AS processing_activity_name, template.template_status, template.current_published_version_id, template.version_no FROM seal.consent_template template JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = template.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE template.consent_template_id = #{templateId}

SELECT version.consent_template_version_id, version.version_number, version.workflow_status, version.title, creator.display_name AS created_by_name, approver.display_name AS approved_by_name, publisher.display_name AS published_by_name FROM seal.consent_template_version version JOIN seal.consent_template template ON template.consent_template_id = version.consent_template_id JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = template.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id JOIN seal.admin_user creator ON creator.admin_user_id = version.created_by LEFT JOIN seal.admin_user approver ON approver.admin_user_id = version.approved_by LEFT JOIN seal.admin_user publisher ON publisher.admin_user_id = version.published_by WHERE template.consent_template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY version.version_number DESC

SELECT template.consent_template_id AS template_id, version.consent_template_version_id AS template_version_id FROM seal.consent_template_version version JOIN seal.consent_template template ON template.consent_template_id = version.consent_template_id JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = template.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE version.consent_template_version_id = #{templateVersionId} AND version.workflow_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') AND version.content_hash IS NOT NULL AND template.template_status = 'ACTIVE' AND activity.activity_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope configured WHERE configured.admin_user_id = #{actorId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope allowed WHERE allowed.admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND allowed.processing_activity_id = activity.processing_activity_id) )

SELECT version.consent_template_version_id AS template_version_id, template.template_code, template.template_name, activity.activity_name, version.version_number FROM seal.consent_template template JOIN seal.consent_template_version version ON version.consent_template_version_id=template.current_published_version_id JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id=template.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id=activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE template.template_status='ACTIVE' AND activity.activity_status='ACTIVE' AND version.workflow_status='PUBLISHED' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope configured WHERE configured.admin_user_id=#{actorId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope allowed WHERE allowed.admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND allowed.processing_activity_id=activity.processing_activity_id)) ORDER BY template.template_code
